keyFindings.description: The pull request conflicts with main. #2405 (INFRA-612) makes remarkReadOnlyDirectives drop every `server` attribute; liveTypedBlocksRemarkPlugin calls it, so after a plain merge the live editor's setMarkdown drops them too and VersionView.tsx:92 draws a past version's answered decision (document text carries state="answered", docs/edits_test.go:335) at its defaults. Build the live step from remarkDecideTypedBlocks + typedBlockRefusal, decide explicitly what a paste does with server attributes, and lock the version view of an answered decision with a test. #2419: the CHANGELOG.md entry becomes packages/envoy/.changes/unreleased/INFRA-624-<slug>.yaml.

Only validContent is relaxed; contentMatchAt, canReplace and ReplaceAroundStep's gap check still read the rule, so in an ask [p, list(Option A, After), list(Option B)] Enter twice at the end of Option B throws 'Called contentMatchAt on a node with invalid content', Backspace at the start of Option A and a selection delete from the question into the first list throw 'Content does not fit in gap' (reviewer's run of the deep review's probes in the real proof-editor stack, happy-dom). The keydown throw skips preventDefault, so the browser's native edit runs [INFERENCE].

Settlement keeps a content-invalid ask's row unchanged, but SetAskBlockText (ask_block_text.go:59-128) reads the joined askBlockOf reading: an urgency-only PATCH passes verifyAskBlockRoundTrip and api/asks.go:440-448 writes options [Ship Hold Defer] to the row while the block still breaks the rule (Go probe); a question-only edit is refused with the misleading 'the block carries 1 options, not 3'.

The test 'Enter in the question of an ask holding two lists keeps every word' places its caret with placeCaret(alicePage, 'after', 'Which one?') at :168, which finds the malformed banner's quote first; More goes into the second list (tester's probe T9). Scope the caret to the ask's question paragraph and show the test fails when the fix is removed.

SERVER_BLOCK_TYPES is tied to pmdoc isBlockNodeType (node.go:417-424) only by a comment; the test compares it with the editor's own block group. A drift makes the editor build asks Validate refuses, refusing the room for every client. Use child.type.isInGroup('block') and pin the server list in a test that fails when Go's list differs.

retypeBlock(id, 'ask') on a heading, code block, list or blockquote now builds an off-rule ask (createChecked passes), contradicting ask-content.ts:32-34 and the CHANGELOG; check contentMatch.matchFragment(...)?.validEnd in retype and canRetype.
A decided (answered/resolved) ask that breaks the rule goes to invalidBlocks and skips writeDecidedWording; the CHANGELOG and AGENTS.md say it 'stays open'. State what happens to a decided one.

readAskBlockStrictly has one caller (askReadability); settlement repeats its content-rule check inline, yet packages/envoy/AGENTS.md:1013 and :2129 cite readAskBlockStrictly as how settlement reads an ask. One named function used by both, cited by the docs.

UNKNOWN_MARK_REFUSAL (:120-131) pins a 200-character Milkdown message the stub throws for any input, with a comment claiming it is what setMarkdown throws, which nothing checks. Use an opaque message.
